d:
Join Coach Liz for this Ultimate Hill Run Workout! This session is designed to take your running game to new heights – literally! Whether you're a beginner looking to build strength and endurance or gearing up for a marathon or half marathon, this workout is your secret weapon.
What You'll Get:
A dynamic warm-up to get you ready
Guided hill repeats to build power and stamina
Tips and motivation to keep you going strong
A cool-down session to wrap it all up
Workout Overview:
Dynamic muscle activations
